condition.yoga_name: Primary Maraka Houses — H2 and H7
condition.trigger_condition: The 2nd and 7th houses are designated Maraka (killer) houses. Lords and occupants of these houses gain power to cause death during their Dasa and Antar-dasa periods when the native's calculated lifespan window coincides.

interpretation.summary: Primary Maraka Houses — H2 and H7
interpretation.detailed:
The 2nd and 7th houses are designated Maraka (killer) houses. Lords and occupants of these houses gain power to cause death during their Dasa and Antar-dasa periods when the native's calculated lifespan window coincides.

Effect: 2nd and 7th lords or occupants become primary killers. House 2 is more lethal than House 7 because it is simultaneously the 12th from the 3rd house (Longevity house) and the 7th from the 8th house (House of Death). This double-terminal positioning grants H2 the primary qualification as the chief killer.

condition.yoga_name: Benefic Killer Trigger — 12th Lord Association

interpretation.summary: Benefic Killer Trigger — 12th Lord Association
interpretation.detailed:
A natural benefic planet (Jupiter, Venus, Mercury waxing, Moon waxing) is related to (conjunct, aspects, or is aspected by) the lord of the 12th house.

Effect: The benefic acquires Maraka power and can inflict death during its Dasa period. Without the 12th lord link, a benefic cannot cause death from the Maraka houses alone.

condition.yoga_name: Maraka Power Hierarchy — Three-Grade Descending Order
condition.trigger_condition: All planets are ranked for Maraka power based on the houses they lord or occupy: Grade 1 (maximum) through Grade 3 (minimum).

interpretation.summary: Maraka Power Hierarchy — Three-Grade Descending Order
interpretation.detailed:
All planets are ranked for Maraka power based on the houses they lord or occupy: Grade 1 (maximum) through Grade 3 (minimum).

Effect: Grade 1 (Maximum Power): Lords or occupants of Houses 12, 3, 8, 7, and 2. Grade 2 (Secondary Killers): Lords or occupants of Houses 6 and 11. Grade 3 (Least Power): Lords or occupants of Houses 5, 9, 10, 4, and 1 — these only become killers if specific secondary criteria (conjunction, asterism, or Moon-centric Maraka rules) are met.

condition.yoga_name: Saturn Killer Priority Override
condition.trigger_condition: Saturn is ill-disposed (debilitated, in enemy sign, combust, or afflicted) AND is related to (conjoins, aspects, or is aspected by) any Grade 1 or Grade 2 Maraka planet.

interpretation.summary: Saturn Killer Priority Override
interpretation.detailed:
Saturn is ill-disposed (debilitated, in enemy sign, combust, or afflicted) AND is related to (conjoins, aspects, or is aspected by) any Grade 1 or Grade 2 Maraka planet.

Effect: Saturn will be the FIRST to kill in preference to all other Maraka planets regardless of their individual Maraka grade. This override supersedes the standard hierarchy and activates Saturn as the primary Maraka for the period in question.

condition.yoga_name: Moon-Centric Dual Maraka Sweep
condition.trigger_condition: The Maraka identification engine executes two sweeps: (1) from the Ascendant (Lagna), and (2) from the Moon sign. In the second sweep, the 2nd and 12th houses are counted from the Moon sign.

interpretation.summary: Moon-Centric Dual Maraka Sweep
interpretation.detailed:
The Maraka identification engine executes two sweeps: (1) from the Ascendant (Lagna), and (2) from the Moon sign. In the second sweep, the 2nd and 12th houses are counted from the Moon sign.

Effect: If the lord of the 2nd or 12th from Moon is a malefic, it qualifies to cause physical death. If the lord is a benefic, it causes only disease and distress, not death. When a planet is a Maraka from the Moon but benefic from the Ascendant, the Moon rule prevails — the planet causes disease rather than death.

condition.yoga_name: Sub-Period Death Prohibition — Benefic Antar-dasa Buffer
condition.trigger_condition: The major Dasa (Maha-dasa) is of a malefic Maraka planet AND the running sub-period (Antar-dasa) belongs to a benefic planet, even if the benefic is related to the malefic Maraka.

interpretation.summary: Sub-Period Death Prohibition — Benefic Antar-dasa Buffer
interpretation.detailed:
The major Dasa (Maha-dasa) is of a malefic Maraka planet AND the running sub-period (Antar-dasa) belongs to a benefic planet, even if the benefic is related to the malefic Maraka.

Effect: Death will NOT occur during this combination. The benefic Antar-dasa acts as a safety buffer even within a malefic Maraka major period. Death instead occurs during the sub-period of an unrelated malefic planet within the same Maha-dasa.

condition.yoga_name: Lifespan Boundary Classes — Four-Tier Classification
condition.trigger_condition: The calculated Ayurdaya (longevity span from Ch 43) is compared to four boundary thresholds to classify the native into a lifespan tier.

interpretation.summary: Lifespan Boundary Classes — Four-Tier Classification
interpretation.detailed:
The calculated Ayurdaya (longevity span from Ch 43) is compared to four boundary thresholds to classify the native into a lifespan tier.

Effect: Short Life: Death before 32 years. Medium Life: Death between 32 and 64 years. Long Life: Death between 64 and 100 years. Supreme Longevity: Life beyond 100 years. The Maraka Dasa must coincide with the calculated boundary of the native's tier for physical death to occur.

condition.yoga_name: Longevity-Maraka Correlation Gate

interpretation.summary: Longevity-Maraka Correlation Gate

This gate is the primary guard against false mortality predictions.
